data.description:
SOCOM JSOC Armory

Back Story

In the aftermath of the Norvinsk conflict, conventional recruitment no longer exists. With the world in chaos and supply lines shattered, the path to becoming a U.S. Navy SEAL has changed.

This is the story of a mysterious soldier attempting to earn the Trident; and with it, access to the SOCOM Armory; through an unconventional trial in the heart of post-apocalyptic Russia.

No one knows where he came from.

One day, a lone soldier appeared in the Norvinsk Special Economic Zone without warning. There were no arrival records, no known PMC affiliation, no callsign, and no name. He simply emerged from the chaos carrying only the cloths on his back and his battle worn equipment.

At first, he was dismissed as just another mercenary trying to survive the collapse. That assumption didn’t last long.

Stories soon spread among Scavs, USEC operators, and even hardened BEAR veterans. Entire firefights ended before anyone realized he had been there. Raiders disappeared from fortified positions without raising an alarm. Rogue patrols were found eliminated with clinical precision. Some claimed they fought beside him, only to discover he had vanished without a trace moments later.

Unlike most soldiers in Tarkov, he never killed for sport.

Scavs who surrendered were often spared. Civilians were left unharmed. Innocent people caught in the crossfire occasionally found food, medicine, or ammunition waiting for them after the fighting had ended. His enemies feared him, but even they spoke of his discipline and honor.

Those who chose to hunt him rarely survived long enough to tell the story.

Rumors quickly followed.

Some believed he had served in Delta Force. Others insisted he claimed to have no military background at all. A few claimed he belonged to a unit so compartmentalized that it officially never existed. None of the stories could ever be confirmed.

Only one thing was certain.

His equipment was unmistakable.

Every rifle was meticulously maintained. Every suppressor bore the marks of countless operations. Every weapon was assembled with the precision and purpose of someone trained to fight at the highest level.

Yet he wore no patch and claimed no recognition.

In the ruins of Tarkov, a new path had emerged.

Those who demonstrate unwavering discipline, professionalism, courage, and honor may be offered the opportunity to undertake the same trials. Success is never guaranteed. Failure is rarely survived.

Only those who prove themselves worthy will earn the right to wear the Trident…

…and gain access to the SOCOM Armory.

What is SOCOM Armory

SOCOM Armory is a high-end military trader specializing in elite weapons, tactical gear, and special operations equipment. More than just a storefront, SOCOM Armory is built around a story-driven progression system where players earn Royalty (REP) by completing dangerous contracts, missions, and objectives for the trader.

As players increase their REP with SOCOM Armory, they unlock new trader levels, granting access to increasingly rare weapons, exclusive attachments, advanced armor, and classified equipment unavailable anywhere else. Every purchase and unlock feels earned, rewarding dedication and creating a meaningful sense of progression.

The journey through SOCOM Armory isn’t simply about buying better gear—it’s about proving yourself worthy of joining an elite network of operators. Each trader level introduces new missions, deeper lore, and greater challenges, transforming the trader into an evolving questline rather than a traditional vendor.

As Special Warfare Operator First Class in the Navy’s most elite unit, DEVGRU, you could gain access to the full arsenal of the SOCOM JSOC Armory; the most sophisticated armory in the world.

# SOCOM Armory 3.0.4 – Change Summary

## Important Notes
- This is for SPT Version 4.0.13. 
- An SPT 4.1.0 compatible version will not be released until the dependency mods are released. 
-  Please do not post comments complaining without offering assistance with troubleshooting. I am more than happy to patch things if you help me. If you just want to complain don't download SOCOM. 
- Any issues requiring more than just a log output such as screenshots or videos, please report them to mt_patriot1776 on Discord. 
- I do not make the assets, I merely modify existing custom or vanilla assets and add them to the trader. 
- Do not report issues specifically mentioning SOCOM in the server log to WTT, Eco, ECOT, or EPIC. Please report them to me so they are not bothered by a mod they didn't create. 

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed red or missing attachments caused by duplicate Unity bundle identities.
- Preserved suppressor-stacking restrictions while allowing intended PRT accessories.
- Moved SOCOM to the latest safe startup position before SPT trader registration. This is to address a possible fix for issues with ACID Progressive Bot low level PMCs. Please report back any issues if the mod load order does not fix this issue. 

## New Features to address duplicate bundles with ECOT, ECO, and and TGC
- Added automatic bundle deduplication.
  - SOCOM scans previously registered bundles for byte-identical files using SHA-256.
  - When an identical bundle is found, SOCOM reuses the existing bundle and redirects only the affected SOCOM items.
  - Bundle reuse and item redirects are reported in the server log.
- Added compatibility safeguards for bundles shared with required mods.

## Bundle Improvements
- Renamed all 10 SOCOM-owned bundles with a unique `_socom` suffix.
- Rebuilt their internal Unity CAB identities to prevent collisions with other mods..

## Compatibility Testing
- Tested alongside 60+ other server mods.
- Audited more than 2,700 installed bundle-manifest entries.
- Confirmed:
  - No missing installed bundle files
  - No cross-mod bundle-key collisions
  - No SOCOM custom-item ID collisions
  - No SOCOM quest or trader ID collisions
  - No duplicate SOCOM internal CAB identities
- Verified successful server startup, client bundle retrieval, trader loading, quest loading, and bundle redirection.

## New Items
- No new items were added in this update.

#### UPDATES:
- Updated WTT-CommonLib to latest version 2.0.23

#### BUG FIXES:
- fixed the assort.json and base.json file names. Changed to lower case only.

#### META CHANGES:
- Added new SOCOM enhanced HK 416 weapon
- Added new SOCOM enhanced HK 416 parts
- Made minor changes to items trader rep to increase difficulty

#### NEW ITEMS:
- HK 416 weapons and parts
- Added FN 5.7 Handgun presets
- Added FN 5.7 mags and accessories
- 3 new Lapua .338 Bolt action rifles
- 338 MK-18 Semi Automatic
- HK G28 7.62x52 DMR
- B5 grips and stocks
- Added mags, muzzle devices, and accessories for .338 weapons
- Added new ammo for 9mm, 45ACP, FN 5.7, and .338

## 3.0.2 CHANGES

### BUG FIXES:
- Patched an incompatibility with SplitAmmoCases mod
- Patched Quest #2 feature image


### META CHANGES:
- Daniel Defense Civilian models such as the DDM4 V7 are now semi-automatic. Models sold to US SOCOM IRL such as the MK-18 and M4A1 are still full auto. 
- Removed all SOCOM custom items from the flee market
- Moved more advanced meds to higher trader rep
- Moved meta ammo up a tier to higher trader rep
- Moved armor rigs and some attachments to higher trader rep
- Removed plates from CPC Chest Rig
- Fixed the price on the M4A1 GL preset
- Added basic meds


### NEW ITEMS:
- New Armor chest rigs and load bearing vests
- New SOCOM enhanced X-25 50 round AR-10 magazine
- Basic meds


![Screenshot 1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MT-Patriot1776/SPT-SOCOM/refs/heads/SOCOM_3.0.2/SOCOM_sourceCode/Resources/db/CustomQuests/SOCOM/Images/trial_by_fire.png)

## NEW IN V3.0

### ALL New Story Line with Quests for trader unlock and royalty system.

### New Items
- Cloned Daniel Defense DD5 7.62 / 308
- Daniel Defense DD5 SBR
- Daniel Defense DD5 V3
- Daniel Defense DD5 V4
- Daniel Defense DD5 w/ FRT Trigger
- Daniel Defense Daniel Defense DD5 parts
- Daniel Defense Vertical Foregrip (Picatinny) by probablyEukyre

![Screenshot 1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MT-Patriot1776/SPT-SOCOM/refs/heads/SOCOM_3.0.0/SOCOM_images/DD%20DD5.png)

### Bug Fix:

Thank you switchlane123 for reporting this bug:

Changed the SOCOM trader unlock sync so it only levels up the SOCOM trader, instead of asking SPT to validate every trader in the player profile. Players were reporting 'SOCOM.Traders.SOCOMTraderUnlockSync' and System.Collections.Generic.KeyNotFoundException errors.

## NEW IN V3.0

### ALL New Story Line with Quests for trader unlock and royalty system.

![Screenshot 1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MT-Patriot1776/SPT-SOCOM/refs/heads/SOCOM_3.0.0/SOCOM_sourceCode/Resources/db/CustomQuests/SOCOM/Images/customs_qrf.png)

### New Items
- Cloned Daniel Defense DD5 7.62 / 308
- Daniel Defense DD5 SBR
- Daniel Defense DD5 V3
- Daniel Defense DD5 V4
- Daniel Defense DD5 w/ FRT Trigger
- Daniel Defense Daniel Defense DD5 parts
- Daniel Defense Vertical Foregrip (Picatinny) by probablyEukyre

![Screenshot 1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MT-Patriot1776/SPT-SOCOM/refs/heads/SOCOM_3.0.0/SOCOM_images/DD%20DD5.png)

# V2.0.3 CHANGES



## New Items:
- Added new Daniel Defense .300 Blackout Weapons
- Added new Daniel Defense .300 Blackout Barrels
- Added .300 Blackout ammo
- Added more custom attachments and magazines


## Bug Fixes:
- Fixed incorrect mod version in SPT Server
- Fixed MFR and ISR III Rails Bi-pod attachments
- Fixed SOCOM trader short name not being recognized by WTT-CommonLib

## General:
- Increased prices

## Images:

![Screenshot 1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MT-Patriot1776/SPT-SOCOM/refs/heads/main/SOCOM_images/SOCOM_Trader_DDM4_3.png)

![Screenshot 2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MT-Patriot1776/SPT-SOCOM/refs/heads/main/SOCOM_images/SOCOM_Trader_DDM4_4.png)
Updated for latest compatibility with WTT-CommonLib and Epics All In One. Added new items
Patched a bug causing the raid screen to freeze while insuring gear with the traders.

- New Dependencies required
- Added Daniel Defense Custom Weapons
- Added Daniel Defense Assets from EpicsAIO
- Increased prices slightly
- Removed cheap meta weapon builds
- Updated source code on GitHub
- Updated for STP 4.0.x Compatibility

versions.description:
Please delete the previous version of the mod before updating! There have been changes in the file paths so files will be left over if you just replace the old mod with the new one!

Remastered tons of items with new textures and shaders! Deduplicated a ton of assets, so despite adding a bunch of stuff the mod size actually went DOWN! Rebalanced the magnification and sensitivity of all scopes in the mod to a standard base. They are all standardized across the board now, if it’s different than BSG’s magnification then I don’t care.

Added:

  • Leupold CQBSS 1-8x Scope
  • Leupold MK5HD 5-25x (Mil FDE) Scope
  • Leupold MK5HD 3.6-18x Scope (Black and FDE)
  • Trijicon Accupower 1-8x Scope
  • Vortex Eleanor 1-10x Scope (Both FDE and Black)
  • Nightforce ATACR F1 1-8x Scope
  • Nightforce ATACR 4-16x Scope
  • Nightforce ATACR 4-20x Scope
  • Kahles K624i 6-24x Scope
  • FDE X-15 5.56 Mag
  • New Daniel Defense RIS II rails
  • KAC 7 Rib rail panel
  • Daniel Defense picatinny rail cover
  • Wilson Combat Starburst pistol grip
  • BCM Gunfighter Mod3 pistol grip

Fixed:

  • Lasers, in general
  • Scope masking, in general
  • Scar rear sight not appearing on scar uppers
  • AK-15 stock compat with new AKs
  • Magnfiiers eye relief

The Wilcox RAID-XE does not work in this version as I am awaiting a new model for it, not happy with the current one.

Enjoy!

versions.description:
• added customisation helper methods
  • bugfixes
  • sanity checks (thanks bushtail)
  • more i’m definitely forgetting

I wonder why commonlib is updating today….

Fixed Fika loading issue with icons!

  • added new ImageManager that works similar to spt’s BundleManager, creating a cache of icons and textures if needed
reduced the error logging to be behind config. MODDERS THAT USE COMMONLIB - ENABLE ITEM DEBUGGING IN THE CONFIG AND FIX YOUR SHIT

• FINALLY fixed salvage zones :prayge:
  • salvage zone UI update + icon!
  • add random craft result amount options
  • initialized buyrestrictioncurrent for traderhelper barters (ty for the detailed bug report!)
  • added client handling for random craft amounts
  • added better validation warnings and a config for validation logging
  • added fixplugintypesserialization patcher (thank you tarkin ❤️)
  • added new quest service for making quest items
  • removed dependency on spt customitemservice

Version so good it jumped a number!

  • new hideout crafting expansion by pein, now supports multi-endproducts and endproducts with nested children
  • reworked custom parent mapping into a server service + client attribute (also by pein)
  • separated logic in the slothelper methods, added a new one

• added new itemservice helper for adding items to blacklist
  • fixed nuget package forcibly including the en.json locale for the salvage zones in your project /bonk
  • fixed slothelper method and added support for creating new slot info
• fixed hideout crafts service not supporting anything but arrays /bonk

• Added new helper to slothelper to add ids by name
  • Added fix custom item sort order patch (thanks Pein! ❤ )
  • Added new “Salvage” zones to possible quest types
  • Added locales for the salvage zone interactions
  • Fixed hideout crafts not supporting .jsonc /bonk

• Implemented random loot container support for customitemserviceextended
  • Added save method to confighelper

HOTFIX NUMBER 2 FOR THE DAY REEEEEEE

  • fixed caliberhelper from being completely broken. PLEASE DOWNLOAD THIS VERSION IF YOU UPDATED TODAY.
• fixed questhelper adding to empty weapon conditions (specifically a punisher part 4 issue)

• added weapon mod quest helper method
  • added CustomDialogueService for custom NPC Dialogues
  • changed CaliberHelper to process deferred like modslots (should allow for better compatibility for ammo)
  • fixed custom modslot images becoming blurry on low texture settings (Thanks Pein!)
added helper method for dogtag quests

• added questhelper
  • force image cache if using fika because of local headless skill issue

What’s Changed:

  • Fixed AddGeneratorFuel by @kittycat2002

• Changed bundle loading methods for Static Spawn Service and Audio Service to load using SPT’s BundleManager, should alleviate any fika issues. THIS WILL REQUIRE ANYONE WHO USES THESE SERVICES TO REGISTER THEIR BUNDLE IN THE BUNDLES.JSON PROPERLY, PLEASE CONSULT THE README
  • Implemented new Custom Customization Service, with support for Hideout Customizations such as floors, ceilings, walls, and shooting range marks, as well as normal customization items like dogtags and such.
